mismatch.sourceBranch: For a known safe pet, domove_core calls domove_attackmon_at and uhitm.c:do_attack before testing/moving. With the recorded rn2(7)=6, do_attack declines the attack; after the tentative move, domove_swap_with_pet rejects the peaceful pet because t_at(u.ux0,u.uy0) is non-NULL. No source branch rejects the move merely because active regions exist.

summary: The existing JS movement preflight rejects every safe-pet destination whenever state.level.regions is non-empty. C has no such admission gate. This recorded case has an active region elsewhere, a physical fire trap under the hero, and a tame dog to the south. C first consumes do_attack’s rn2(7)=6, then reaches domove_swap_with_pet, whose origin-tile t_at check prints the refusal and restores the hero. JS throws “pet swap region crossing” before that draw. Remove the overbroad regions rejection from requireOrdinarySafeMonsterSwap; keep the source-ordered origin trap refusal in domove_swap_with_pet and let later in_out_region handling decide actual region crossings.

source.branch: domove_core calls domove_attackmon_at for the adjacent safe pet at 2789-2799. domove_attackmon_at calls uhitm.c:do_attack at 1987; do_attack’s safe-monster arm consumes rn2(7) and returns FALSE when the draw does not select the attack branch. After test_move and in_out_region, domove_core tentatively moves and calls domove_swap_with_pet at 2919-2924. That helper rejects a peaceful monster when goodpos(old hero square) fails or t_at(old hero square) is non-NULL at 2153-2161.
callers: hack.c:domove_core calls domove_attackmon_at for the destination monster before test_move and in_out_region
hack.c:domove_core calls domove_swap_with_pet after the tentative movement and region gate
js/hack.js:domove calls preflightDomoveDestination before the movement path; domove_attackmon_at and domove_swap_with_pet are already wired to the corresponding callers
dependencies: Existing JS domove_swap_with_pet implements the C origin trap refusal through t_at(oldX, oldY) and reports the same source message.

Existing JS do_attack implements the safe-monster rn2(7) decision. The correction only removes the premature active-regions refusal from requireOrdinarySafeMonsterSwap; no new C helper or RNG behavior is required.
